info.name: E-Commerce Microservices Platform (Spring Boot 3 + Kafka + Razorpay)
info.description:
End-to-end Postman Collection v2.1 for the 10-microservice E-Commerce application.
- Collection-level Bearer JWT Auth (`{{jwtToken}}`) automatically populated by the Login request test scripts.
- Admin routes use `{{adminToken}}`; Razorpay `/v1/*` routes use Basic Auth (`{{razorpayKeyId}}:{{razorpayKeySecret}}`).
